purpose: Additional emotions, playmates, pups and weather scenes

entries.label: Shy smile
entries.action: One main Moru,70%cell width centered. Slowly notices viewer, glances down bashfully, tilts head gently, raises ONE short front flipper to its cheek without covering either eye or diamond nose, closes both eyes in a soft smiling arc, lowers flipper, looks up warmly and settles to exact neutral. No blush dots, hearts or extra props. Gentle readable emotion, no sadness or panic.
